title: Magnetic Field
content: The magnetic field is a region where magnetic effects can be detected.
e: The magnetic field is a region where magnetic effects can be detected. Magnetic Field is the region around a magnet where magnetic effects show up. A magnetic field line leaves the north pole and returns into the south pole.

title: Magnetisation
content: A process of making a magnetic material into a magnet is called magnetisation.
e: A process of making a magnetic material into a magnet is called magnetisation. Every magnet has a north pole and a south pole, and like poles push apart involving magnetic.

title: Induced Magnetism
content: Induced magnetism occurs when a piece of unmagnetised magnetic material is brought near to the pole of a permanent magnet, causing it to be attracted and become a magnet itself.
e: Induced magnetism occurs when a piece of unmagnetised magnetic material is brought near to the pole of a permanent magnet, causing it to be attracted and become a magnet itself. Every magnet has a north pole and a south pole, and like poles push apart.

title: Hard Magnetic Materials
content: Magnetic materials such as steel which are harder to magnetise but retain their magnetism longer are called hard magnetic materials.
e: Magnetic materials such as steel which are harder to magnetise but retain their magnetism longer are called hard magnetic materials. Hard Magnetic Materials is measured or named exactly that way in this chapter.

title: Soft Magnetic Materials
content: Magnetic materials such as iron or special alloys like mumetal alloy which are easier to magnetise but do not retain their magnetism very long are called soft magnetic materials.
e: Magnetic materials such as iron or special alloys like mumetal alloy which are easier to magnetise but do not retain their magnetism very long are called soft magnetic materials. Soft Magnetic Materials is measured or named exactly that way in this chapter.
